community_list_entries.name: GateMem: Benchmarking Memory Governance in Multi-Principal Shared-Memory Agents

phase1_classification.kind_reason: A benchmark for multi-principal shared-memory agents with 91 multi-party episodes (~223 turns each) and 2,218 hidden checkpoints. It scores utility under state updates, access control, and active forgetting after deletion requests.
